facts.item: Q2FY27 results: consolidated revenue Rs7,422 cr (+20% YoY), EBITDA Rs1,760 cr (margin ~23.7%), net profit Rs1,573 cr, EPS Rs57.31 (Screener). Investor presentation dated 13-Nov-2026.
Motilal Oswal: Neutral, target Rs7,420 (DSIJ summary).
ICICI Securities (institutional): Buy, Rs9,000; RE 30x Sep-28E EPS (~Rs8,400) + VECV 10x EV/EBITDA (~Rs600); Q2 EBITDA margin 23.3% (standalone), ~120bp below its estimate; FY27E EPS cut 2.9%.
Nomura maintains Neutral and cuts its target after a Q2 margin miss.
